# PhysioNetPhysiology

**Network Physiology for the Physio ecosystem** — dynamic-interaction
analysis of coupled physiological systems (brain, heart, respiration,
muscle).

Single-modality tools cannot ask how *different* organ systems couple
and reorganise together. This package does, on top of the multimodal
`PhysioExperiment` data model, via **Time Delay Stability (TDS)**
(Bashan et al. 2012): it tracks, over sliding windows, the time lag that
maximises each signal pair’s cross-correlation, and rewards periods
where that lag stays put — the fingerprint of a genuine dynamic
coupling. Stable couplings become links in an *organ-interaction
network*, and the package measures how that network **reconfigures
across physiological states**.

``` r

# nodes = physiological systems sampled on a common (slow) grid
X <- physioNodeMatrix(list(
  brain = eeg_beta_power,   # e.g. from PhysioEEG
  heart = heart_rate,       # e.g. from PhysioECG
  resp  = respiration,      # e.g. from PhysioECG
  muscle = emg_envelope     # e.g. from PhysioEMG
))

# 1. Time Delay Stability between every pair
tds <- timeDelayStability(X, sampling_rate = 1,
                          window_sec = 60, max_lag_sec = 4)
summary(tds)

# 2. Organ-interaction network, links significance-tested vs surrogates
net <- tdsNetwork(tds, surrogate = TRUE, X = X)
plotTDSnetwork(net)

# 3. How the network reconfigures across states (e.g. sleep stages)
bystate <- tdsNetworkByState(X, states = sleep_stage,
                             window_sec = 60, max_lag_sec = 4)
byState_recon <- bystate$reconfiguration
plotTDSreconfiguration(byState_recon)
```

## Why TDS

TDS is robust to the amplitude non-stationarity of physiological signals
and to differing signal types (it operates on the *timing* of coupling,
not its strength), which is why it underlies the Network-Physiology
programme. Links are significance-tested against **phase-randomised
surrogates** that preserve each signal’s own spectrum while destroying
cross-signal timing.

## Scope

The core engine works on any multivariate time series; the
[`physioNodeMatrix()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/physioNodeMatrix.md)
helper and the `PhysioExperiment` integration make organ-system assembly
convenient. Reference: Bashan et al. (2012) *Nat Commun* 3:702; Bartsch
et al. (2015) *PLoS ONE* 10:e0142143.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`aggregateNetwork()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/aggregateNetwork.md)
  : Aggregate a multiplex into a single weighted network
- [`cardiacPhaseFromPeaks()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/cardiacPhaseFromPeaks.md)
  : Cardiac phase from R-peak marks
- [`cardiorespiratoryCoupling()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/cardiorespiratoryCoupling.md)
  : Analyse cardiorespiratory coupling
- [`heartbeatEvokedPotential()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/heartbeatEvokedPotential.md)
  : Heartbeat-evoked potential (HEP)
- [`hepAmplitude()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/hepAmplitude.md)
  : Amplitude of the HEP in a component window
- [`hepSignificance()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/hepSignificance.md)
  : Permutation significance of the HEP component
- [`instantaneousPhase()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/instantaneousPhase.md)
  : Instantaneous phase of a signal
- [`layerSimilarity()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/layerSimilarity.md)
  : Pairwise layer similarity
- [`moduleRoles()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/moduleRoles.md)
  : Node module roles (Guimera-Amaral)
- [`multiplexDegree()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/multiplexDegree.md)
  : Per-layer and overlapping (multiplex) degree
- [`multiplexNetwork()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/multiplexNetwork.md)
  : Construct a multiplex network
- [`multiplexParticipation()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/multiplexParticipation.md)
  : Multiplex participation coefficient
- [`nmPhaseSynchronization()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/nmPhaseSynchronization.md)
  : Scan n:m phase-locking over a grid of ratios
- [`participationCoefficient()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/participationCoefficient.md)
  : Participation coefficient
- [`phaseSynchronizationIndex()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/phaseSynchronizationIndex.md)
  : n:m phase-locking index
- [`physioNodeMatrix()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/physioNodeMatrix.md)
  : Assemble a physiological node matrix
- [`plotDelayStability()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/plotDelayStability.md)
  : Plot the optimal-lag series and stable periods for a pair
- [`plotHEP()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/plotHEP.md)
  : Plot a heartbeat-evoked potential
- [`plotSynchrogram()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/plotSynchrogram.md)
  : Plot a cardiorespiratory synchrogram
- [`plotTDSnetwork()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/plotTDSnetwork.md)
  : Plot a TDS organ-interaction network
- [`plotTDSreconfiguration()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/plotTDSreconfiguration.md)
  : Plot network reconfiguration across states
- [`supraAdjacency()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/supraAdjacency.md)
  : Supra-adjacency matrix of a multiplex
- [`synchrogram()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/synchrogram.md)
  : Cardiorespiratory synchrogram
- [`tdsNetwork()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/tdsNetwork.md)
  : Build an organ-interaction network from TDS
- [`tdsNetworkByState()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/tdsNetworkByState.md)
  : State-resolved organ-interaction networks
- [`tdsReconfiguration()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/tdsReconfiguration.md)
  : Link-level reconfiguration between two states
- [`tdsSurrogateThreshold()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/tdsSurrogateThreshold.md)
  : Surrogate significance threshold for TDS links
- [`timeDelayStability()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/timeDelayStability.md)
  : Time Delay Stability across a multivariate physiological series
- [`withinModuleDegreeZ()`](https://x-biosignal.github.io/PhysioNetPhysiology/reference/withinModuleDegreeZ.md)
  : Within-module degree z-score
